certification.name: GIAC Experienced Forensics Analyst
certification.description: Applied Knowledge exam of 25 CyberLive hands-on challenges in four hours, open book, covering Windows file system artifacts, system triage, memory analysis, event analysis and enterprise threat hunting. Counts toward the GSE portfolio.
certification.currency_note: Applied Knowledge exam; $499 for holders of the corresponding active base Practitioner certification (GCFA is the audience named on the page)
